title: Korean Stocks Bear Brunt of Chip Selloff on Higher Yield Worry
summary: South Korea led a selloff in Asian chip stocks, as rising bond yields exacerbated worry over the large sums of cash being shelled out by Big Tech.

title: Terton Opposes Korea’s Golfzon on Second Buyout Bid
summary: A second attempt to take South Korea’s Golfzon Holdings Co. private is facing renewed resistance from a minority shareholder, with the stock now trading above the tender price in a sign the buyer may struggle to win over investors on the current terms.

title: Japan Bond Volatility Is Pumping Up Futures Trading in Singapore
summary: Global funds and relative-value traders are driving a surge in Japan bond futures trading in Singapore, drawn by rising volatility.

title: Hitachi Construction Shares Drop After $740 Million Block Trade
summary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co.’s shares fell the most in almost three weeks after its major shareholder Hitachi Ltd. offloaded all holding, in the latest move by the Japanese conglomerate to divest some of its assets to focus on core businesses.

title: Gold Holds Losses as Bond Selloff, Hormuz Limbo Weigh on Outlook
summary: Gold steadied after the biggest drop in almost a month as a bond rout and deadlock in the Strait of Hormuz dimmed the outlook for the precious metal.

title: Chip Selloff Extends to Asia, Treasuries Stabilize: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks dropped as a semiconductor selloff deepened, with investors retreating from one of the year’s hottest trades amid elevated bond yields and geopolitical uncertainty. Treasuries stabilized after recent losses.

title: Evergrande Liquidators Challenge Hong Kong Watchdog in Court
summary: A Hong Kong court is set to hear arguments on whether a deal that set up a fund to compensate China Evergrande minority shareholders is valid.

title: Australian Housing Shares Surge as Earnings Defy Property Slump
summary: Shares of two of Australia’s largest property developers surged after stronger full-year earnings showed resilience in the face of a housing market downturn.

title: Japanese Stocks Slide as Bond Market Anxiety Hits AI Sentiment
summary: Japan’s Nikkei Stock Average slumped for a second day, weighed down by chip-related stocks as anxiety over surging bond yields sapped risk appetite from the AI trade.

title: Trump Takes Hard Line as Hormuz Tensions Mark New Normal
summary: US President Donald Trump insisted that there were no talks ongoing with Iran, leaving the conflict in the Middle East and control of the Strait of Hormuz stuck in limbo. Bloomberg's Jeff Mason shares his perpective. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China Bonds Buck Global Selloff on Policy Divide With Peers
summary: A relentless drop in China’s long-end yields is driving an aggressive curve flattening, laying bare a stark macro rift with global markets where long-dated rates have hit multi-year peaks.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 19
summary: Oil rose for a fourth day, with no sign of progress toward a resolution of the US-Iran war after almost six months of conflict.

title: JBS Seeks Rest of Pilgrim’s Pride Stake in $1.2 Billion Deal
summary: Pilgrim’s Pride Corp. shares jumped after meatpacking giant JBS NV offered to acquire the shares of the chicken producer it doesn’t already own in a stock deal valued at about $1.2 billion.

title: Hong Kong Exchanges’ Non-Equity Push Seen as Key for Stock Boost
summary: With record trading volumes and new listings providing little boost for shares of Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing Ltd., analysts are increasingly looking for a jolt from the company’s expansion of non-equity business.

title: Fletcher Building Waits on Meaningful Recovery in NZ Demand
summary: New Zealand’s largest construction materials company Fletcher Building Ltd. doesn’t expect a meaningful recovery in its markets until 2027, adding to signs of muted economic growth over the second half of this year.

title: Japan’s Earnings Surprise Analysts to Fuel Bets for Broad Rally
summary: Japanese companies posted their largest earnings beat in five years despite soaring oil costs, fueling hopes that strong profit growth across sectors can broaden the market rally beyond AI-related trades.

title: Roz Brewer Talks College Aid, Walgreens During Covid and Retail
summary: Spelman College Chair Emerita Rosalind "Roz" Brewer, former CEO of Walgreens Boots Alliance, says that she "never looked back to the lab" after moving from working as an organic chemist at Kimberly-Clarke to moving to the corporate side of the business. Speaking to Romaine Bostick at Bloomberg New Voices in Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, Brewer says that the timing of her joining Walgreens during the Covid-19 pandemic gave her the best chance to make changes, as times of crisis often provide the best opportunities to do so. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gluten-Free Brand Breaks Out in Saturated Market
summary: Feel Good Foods has been selling gluten-free frozen foods since 2012, eventually starting to outsell legacy frozen food brands like PF Chang's and TGI Fridays. CEO Vanessa Phillips founded the brand after being diagnosed with celiac disease and college, and refusing to give up her favorite foods. She says the brand doesn't just serve gluten-free consumers, saying most customers buy the product because it "works for them and their lifestyle." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: KKR Real Estate Lender’s Woes Attract Investment Firm Mavik
summary: An investment firm that specializes in commercial real estate distress is betting that a lender managed by KKR & Co. is likely to sell its loan portfolio at or around book value.

title: Roz Brewer Says US Retail Needs Global Partners
summary: Spelman College Chair Emerita Rosalind "Roz" Brewer, former CEO of Walgreens Boots Alliance, discusses the state of the US consumer in the current economy with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick at the Bloomberg New Voices event in Martha’s Vineyard. (Source: Bloomberg)
